'''Sord Trunnel''' was a [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] who was a high-ranking member of the [[Exchange]] crime syndicate during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> By around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Sord Trunnel" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> he was present on<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]].<ref name="TOR" />
	
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the two rival governments sent one of their companions to do business with Trunnel. The companion delivered a shipment for him, but Trunnel attempted to withhold their payment. However, they ensured that Trunnel paid what he owed, along with a bonus.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sord Trunnel was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission of the same name in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the video game.<ref name="TOR" />
